D4a-06 rule, written before any clustering (the floor from out/_analysis/d4a06_floor.py, read before this line: of 684 rooms with changes, 126 hold 1 to 4 and reach a median of 2 fourth-order themes or fewer; rooms with 5 reach a median of 3). (1) The floor: a room helps define the forms only if it holds 5 or more placed selected changes (558 rooms); the 126 thin rooms are placed afterwards; the 21 rooms with none stay the core. (2) Features as at D4a-05: each selected line counts at its third-order theme, fourth-order theme and dimension (arrows through their source's third-order theme); shares within each level; third-order themes changed by only one defining room dropped; Hellinger at each level, the levels counting equally; Ward on the defining rooms. (3) The count, k = 4 to 8, by two measures that do not favour more groups: (a) the gap between Ward merge heights, the height at which the k-group cut ends minus the height at which it begins (its lifetime), largest gap carried; (b) stability on matched subsamples: 100 pairs of subsamples, each 80 per cent of the defining rooms drawn without replacement (seed 0), Ward on each, adjusted Rand between the two cuts on the rooms they share; the same on 20 column-shuffled copies of the data, 20 pairs each (seed 1); the margin is the real mean less the shuffled mean. The k carried is the one with the largest stability margin (a tie within 0.005 goes to the smaller k); the gap's k is reported beside it; if they disagree, both cuts are given in full, the stability cut first. (4) Signatures: the fourth-order themes a form's defining members change at 1.5 times or more the defining population's share, in a third or more of them. (5) Placement, J's rule: every room with changes, defining or thin, goes to the form whose signature themes hold most of its selected changes, by count. A tie is listed, and the room goes to the tied form whose centre its whole mix is nearest. A room with none of its changes on any signature is placed by its whole mix and flagged. Secondary forms: the other forms whose signatures hold 25 per cent or more of its changes. Signatures are not recomputed after placement. Counted: the rooms whose signature placement differs from their whole-mix placement (the Ward cut for defining rooms, the nearest centre for thin rooms). (6) Reading: per form, the three best fits (the largest share of changes on the signature, then more changes) and the misfits (members the whole mix puts there and the signature rule takes away, and members placed with the smallest signature share), read through their lines' how sentences; one kind of organizing or a mixture. (7) Named sets, from the ledger: raiding rooms, those with a selected change at T3-006 (calling to deface rivals' work) or in T4-020 (repertoire of contention); takeover rooms, the members of F02 (the takeover run as a temporary regime); rich rooms fit without change, the core's rooms by coded concepts, r/startrek among them. (8) Afterwards, as at D4a-05, the forms against the rooms' codes.

D4a-06 run read (out/_analysis/d4a06_room_forms.py, output d4a06_forms.json; d4a06_facts2.py; read before this line). Floor 5: 558 defining rooms, 126 thin, 21 core; columns 144 third-order, 28 fourth-order, 8 dimensions. The count: the merge-height gap carries k = 5 (lifetimes k4 0.054, k5 0.323, k6 0.100, k7 0.144, k8 0.030); matched-subsample stability carries k = 8 (margins over the shuffled null 0.059, 0.067, 0.072, 0.082, 0.088; real means 0.150 to 0.206 against null 95th percentiles 0.163 to 0.174; at k = 4 the real mean is below the null's 95th percentile). The measures disagree; by the logged rule the stability cut (k = 8) is carried and the gap cut (k = 5) given in full. At k = 5 the largest Ward group (164) has no signature: it is k = 8's B, G and H merged, the middle of the continuum, a broad form under J's instruction. k = 8, Ward sizes 151, 81, 78, 62, 57, 46, 43, 40 (ratio 3.78); after J's placement A 135, B 84, C 89, D 50, E 62, F 64, G 124, H 76 (ratio 2.70); 239 rooms move against the whole mix (229 defining, 10 thin), 181 placements are ties, 11 rooms touch no signature. Form G grows from 43 to 124: its signature theme (collective representation) is one many rooms change, so a count rule draws rooms to it. Named sets: raiding rooms 102 (any attack-call change; median share 0.146), at k = 8 H 33, F 21, A 15, G 11, B 7, D 6, C 5, E 4; of the 27 rooms with a quarter or more of their changes on attack calls, 19 are in H and 6 in F. Takeover rooms (F02, 33): A 8, B 7, H 7, G 4, D 2, E 2, F 2, C 1; their frame changes are a median 0.143 of their changes, and no form's signature holds the frame. The core: r/startrek, 137 coded concepts and 28 accepted lines, all instantiate; the other 20 core rooms hold 1 to 22 coded concepts. Codes at k = 8: pseudo-F 8.25 against a null 95th percentile of 1.24 (p 0.001), 7.9 per cent of the variation. Rand index against the D4a-05 forms 0.196.
